title: Polynomial time and polynomial-size circuits
statement: If there is a language in $\mathsf{NP}$ that is not decidable by any family of Boolean circuits of fan-in at most two whose size is bounded by a polynomial, then $\mathsf{P} \ne \mathsf{NP}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathsf{NP}$ is not a subset of the class of languages decidable by polynomial-size fan-in-two Boolean circuit families
